label: first token is 2, n, or l
explanation: Fires only at step t=0, and only when the first original token is the digit 2, the letter n, or the letter l. Every such step fires, and nothing else does (dev P=R=1.0). Magnitude depends on the token: 2 is strongest (about 0.029, 82% of activation mass), n is in between (about 0.007, 18%), and l is barely above threshold (about 0.0003, under 1%). Never active at later original steps, at the delimiter, or during the copy phase, and never for any other first token. Since the profile shows L does not change whether it fires (rate 0.10 at t=0 across all L), it acts as a token-identity detector at sequence start.

issues: None material. Test split: precision 1, recall 1 and mass recall 1, with 0 misses and 0 false positives. The per-token mass shares on test are 2 = 81%, n = 18%, l = 0.6%, matching the claimed 82/18/<1 (dev). Dropping l gives mass recall 0.994 and recall 0.66, as claimed. The profile confirms activity only at t=0, with no activity at the delimiter or in the copy phase.
